old_contract_delisting.title: Binance Futures Will Delist TLM and ICP USDT-Margined Contracts
quoted_original_sentences: Binance Futures will conduct automatic settlements on the TLM USDT-Margined Contracts at 2022-06-09 09:00 (UTC) and ICP USDT-Margined Contracts at 2022-06-10 09:00 (UTC).
Both contracts will be delisted after the settlements are complete.
Binance Futures will launch USDⓈ-M ICP perpetual contracts with up to 25x leverage on 2022-09-27 at 02:30 (UTC).
The symbol for the old ICPUSDT contract, which was previously delisted at 2022-06-10 09:00 (UTC), has been updated to ICPUSDT_SETTLED in users' transaction histories, where applicable.

official_lifecycle.conclusion: ICPUSDT 为**同一符号、两代合约**：旧合约 2022-06-10 交割退市（符号改 ICPUSDT_SETTLED）；新合约 2022-09-27 02:30 UTC 上市。两代之间为官方『无合约窗口』。
